title: Judgment — Document #1007
docketDescription: FILED JUDGMENT IN A CRIMINAL CASE as to Devon Archer (6), Count(s) 1, 1s, 2, 2s are dismissed on the motion of the US. Found guilty to Count(s) 1ss, 2ss, Imprisonment for a total term of 1 Year, 1 day on both counts to run concurrent. Supervised release for a term of 1 Year on both counts to run concurrently. The court makes the following recommendations to the Bureau of Prisons: It is recommended that the defendant be designated to a facility in or near the New York City area. In light of the fact that the parties intend to brief the issue of whether a stay is warranted, the Court has not yet scheduled a surrender date. Special Assessment of $200 which is due immediately. Restitution of $43,427,436.00 (Signed by Judge Ronnie Abrams on 3/7/22)(jw) (Entered: 03/07/2022)

title: Order for Forfeiture of Property — Document #1023
docketDescription: PRELIMINARY ORDER OF FORFEITURE/MONEY JUDGMENT as to Devon Archer. NOW, THEREFORE, IT IS HEREBY ORDERED, ADJUDGED AND DECREED THAT As a result of the offenses charged in Counts One and Two of the Indictment, to which the Defendant pled guilty, a money judgment in the amount of $15,700,513 in United States currency (the "Money Judgment"), for which the Defendant is jointly and severally liable with the money judgments entered against co-defendants, Jason Galanis, Gary Hirst, John Galanis, Bevan Cooney and Michelle Morton in this case, representing the amount of proceeds traceable to the commission of the offenses charged in Counts One and Two of the Indictment that the Defendant personally obtained, shall be entered against the Defendant. (Signed by Judge Ronnie Abrams on 5/13/22)(jw) (Entered: 05/13/2022)
